gateSummaries.message: Verified 6-stage CI/CD DAG model parity, SHA-256 scanner pins, Trivy 0.69.4 compromise denylist, and OWASP CICD-SEC-01..10 controls.
Scanned 212 Python modules, 33 MCP tool schemas (T1-T3 zero-TIN), and 5 OpenTofu HCL modules with 0 findings.
Scanned 39 TypeScript modules plus Node BFF & Service Worker for DOM-XSS, Trusted Types, CSP Level 3, and fail-closed BFF boundaries.

Executed 8 live in-process ASGI & MCP DAST probe suites (Host injection, ASVS headers, DoS caps, prod fail-closed, staff 403, ASI02/03 subject smuggling, MCP transport fuzzing, and ASI01 prompt injection).
